landing.introduction: HUAYUN Code helps you plan, architect, code, and debug for CrownCAD secondary development with a focused AI workflow.
landing.accountMention: To get started, connect your HUAYUN Code Cloud account or choose a model provider directly.

providerSignup.useAnotherProviderDescription: Enter an API key and get going.
